key_insight: Jet-RL enables end-to-end on-policy RL in FP8 by unifying precision across rollout and training paths, preserving numerical stability while dramatically reducing rollout compute and memory overhead.
problem_solved: Rollout dominates on-policy RL training time and cost, and existing pipelines that mix FP8 rollouts with higher-precision training introduce data movement, conversion overhead, and numerical instability—blocking efficient, large-scale RL for LLMs.
method: Unified precision flow: apply FP8 consistently across rollout and training to eliminate frequent precision conversions and streamline data paths.

Numerical stabilization: use calibrated scaling and quantization-aware techniques (e.g., dynamic scaling, variance-aware quantization/loss scaling) to retain on-policy training fidelity in low precision.
System and kernel co-design: optimize memory layout and compute kernels to exploit FP8 hardware efficiently and accelerate rollout throughput without degrading policy performance.
impact: Makes on-policy RL far more compute- and memory-efficient, enabling faster iteration, lower cost, and wider adoption of RL fine-tuning for LLMs and other large models while maintaining training stability and policy quality.

paper_title: Jet-RL: Enabling On-Policy FP8 Reinforcement Learning with Unified Training and Rollout Precision Flow
paper_authors: Haocheng Xi, Charlie Ruan, Peiyuan Liao, Yujun Lin, Han Cai
